divergences: src/codec.ts is byte-identical to the source (no imports to rewrite). Its doc comments still use retired-product vocabulary (CreatorBot, Martian, ARCHITECTURE section refs); kept verbatim on purpose.
src/operators.ts: the only change is the import specifier './genome-codec.js' -> './codec.js'.
Nothing was pulled from constants.ts, utils.ts or types.ts: genome-codec.ts has no imports and genome-operators.ts imports only genome-codec.ts.

Ported tests: only import specifiers changed ('../../src/alienclaw/registry/genome-codec.js' -> '../src/codec.js', '.../genome-operators.js' -> '../src/operators.js'). fixture-runner.test.ts additionally resolves the fixture at 'fixtures/genome-spec-fixtures.json' (was '../fixtures/...'). Header comments that name in-tree paths are left as-is.

test/property.test.ts is renamed from test/genome/test_property_genome.ts. The in-tree file does not match vitest's *.test.ts include glob, so it has never been collected by the in-tree suite; the staged copy IS collected and runs.
New files with no in-tree source: package.json, tsconfig.json, README.md, PROVENANCE.json, src/index.ts (re-exports codec + operators), test/fixture-sync.test.ts, test/parity-in-tree.test.ts.

tsconfig.json mirrors the root one (strict, nodenext, noEmit, types [node]) but pins lib [es2022] (no DOM) and drops esModuleInterop and resolveJsonModule (unused). noUncheckedIndexedAccess was not enabled: the verbatim fixture runner destructures Record<string,string> values and would need non-import edits.

Not ported: tests that exercise the codec only through DROP areas (test/registry/registry.test.ts, martian-registry.test.ts, ms-loader.test.ts, test/governance/common/random-genome.test.ts, test/wiring/*, test/msb/*) and test/api/* (api validation layer, not the codec). test/evolution/reflective/genome-codec.test.ts covers a different module (evolution/reflective/genome-codec.ts) and is out of scope.
